item.title: ‘Zero Pending’, Zero Safety, Zero HCWs: The Burning Crisis At Queen Elizabeth Hospital — Health Worker
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
To hit a 4-hour ETD clearance target at Queen Elizabeth Hospital, patients are pushed out of the emergency room and dumped into a multidisciplinary ward, regardless of their diagnosis or stability. Staff who try to delay unsafe admissions are threatened. The post ‘Zero Pending’, Zero Safety, Zero HCWs: The Burning Crisis At Queen Elizabeth Hospital — Health Worker appeared first on CodeBlue .

item.title: Malaysia Faces Emerging Shortage Of Dialysers, Haemodialysis Components
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
Malaysia is facing an emerging shortage of dialysers (artificial kidney) and canister/bottle packaging for haemodialysis (HD) concentrate solution. A dialyser is necessary for HD. Nephrologists say kidney failure patients can't survive without dialysis. The post Malaysia Faces Emerging Shortage Of Dialysers, Haemodialysis Components appeared first on CodeBlue .

item.title: Expedite Intake For Permanent Positions For Reserve Pharmacists, Dental Officers — Pharmacist
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
We hope the authorities can expedite the intake for permanent positions for contract pharmacists and dentists and provide clarity on the status of those who are still waiting. Some 350 pharmacists are on the reserve list; validity ends on Oct 20, 2026.
